title: ChatGPT or API key
blurb: In Settings → AI or AI Setup, choose Sign in with ChatGPT to use an eligible plan, or use an API key and custom endpoint. Fetch models for the current connection, choose one, and save before testing. Saving ChatGPT keeps the saved API settings unless you edited them. The app uses the saved connection when you start an AI action. Timeline and Case still require reviewed mail and Generate. Automatic processing defaults to Only when requested. Choose Run background AI for Brain refresh, opening Agent triage, opening reply suggestions and scheduled skills. It applies to the saved provider, model and account. A change to that connection turns background AI off. Changing the connection or turning automatic processing off cancels pending work for the previous setting. ChatGPT sign-in supports multiple registrations, cancellation and a one-time callback if needed. Manage usage opens ChatGPT settings.
